oliver_cs: draft for customers affected by the onboarding ingestion delay. short + practical. please review: summary, RCA, mitigation, timeline, credits, and invite to office hours.

mina_eng: RCA: a config change modified shard routing for the ingestion queue at ~02:58 UTC which caused a subset of workers to be rate-limited. rollback at 03:30 UTC. backfill in progress; throughput ~80-90%. ETA for full catch-up 5-7 hours depending on queue spikes.

tara_pm: call out renewal-impacting accounts and suggest AE/SE outreach. offer a 30-min implementation review for renewal talks and a one-time onboarding credit. tone: apologetic + actionable.

oliver_cs: outbound draft below (please tweak):

oliver_cs: ```Hi <Customer>,
We9re sorry. Earlier today (around 03:00 UTC) a configuration change affected our onboarding ingestion pipeline causing delays for some uploads and trial imports. We reverted the change and started a backfill; processing is ongoing and we expect full catch-up within 57 hours.

Why this happened: a queue-shard routing config mismatch caused throttling of a subset of ingestion workers (incident INC-2026-38121).
What we did: rolled back the rollout, scaled up backfill workers by 3x, patched the shard routing logic, and added extra monitoring.
Impact: no data loss. Search/embeddings completeness will be restored when backfill completes.
Next steps: we9re hosting two office hours today (14:00 & 18:00 UTC) for affected customers. We9ll also provide a one-time onboarding credit (capped as described below). If you9re in a renewal window or need prioritized help, reply and we9ll schedule a 30-minute review with Solutions Engineering and your AE.
Thanks for your patience.



Alex (Customer Success)```

mina_eng: edit: change "scaled up backfill workers by 3x" -> "temporarily increased backfill worker capacity by 3x and patched shard routing". add link to public status: https://redwood.status/incidents/INC-2026-38121

status_bot: INC-2026-38121 status: RESOLVED (rollback + backfill triggered). public reference: https://redwood.status/incidents/INC-2026-38121 :white_check_mark:

reza_se: I can host the office hours and take notes on common customer blockers. please attach RSVP + a 1-page troubleshooting checklist so we can triage quickly.

tara_pm: I9ll flag renewal accounts and ping AEs for the SEP handoff. legal, pls confirm credit wording e29850

oliver_cs: final send checklist: 1) legal credit cap language confirmed 2) priority list appended with renewal flags 3) RSVP link + calendar invites 4) SEP/AE tags. target outbound at 09:30 UTC.

mina_eng: legal ok with "one-time credit up to X" phrasing; legal will DM exact copy.
